entries.text: StarRocks sessions concatenate with ||, wait for asynchronous index changes, drop tables and databases without the recycle bin so repeated runs no longer fill the backend disk, create updatable staging tables with the primary key model, and run explicit transactions with BEGIN, one INSERT per table and series from generate_series().

Write and Transaction Primitives skip the StarRocks operations whose errors are cited (MERGE, RETURNING, bulk file loads, UPDATE, DELETE, SAVEPOINT and temporary tables inside a transaction), and Write Primitives cleanup deletes use predicates StarRocks accepts.

Read Primitives has StarRocks variants for quantiles, JSON, maps, structs, lambdas, UNNEST, ASOF, regression statistics, moving frames and GROUP BY/ORDER BY ALL and skips the full-text queries that need a GIN index; QUALIFY is rewritten to a filtered subquery.

TPC-H Havoc rewrites FILTER aggregates, named windows, ORDER BY subqueries, empty GROUP BY, correlated scalar GROUP BY and sourceless EXISTS for StarRocks, and skips the one variant that references an outer column inside a derived table.
